description: Starts the Monatsreporting run (month-end close) for a month, only when that month has NO run yet (any status except failed/superseded counts, including signed-off months). Otherwise nothing is written and the existing run is returned with already_exists true, its status and a deeplink, so calling it twice is safe. It never replaces a run; restarting happens only in the app, with confirmation. The month must have booking data, otherwise NO_DATA_FOR_PERIOD is returned and no run is created. Starting normalizes the figures, collects anomaly cases and checks due watch items against them (no approval). Nothing runs in the background afterwards: AI reviews and comment drafts are created only when a person asks for them in the app. Follow-up tools: get-month-run-status, list-open-anomaly-cases.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

name: start-month-run
